claims.statement: If A_LL=D+B0+E with D diagonal, rank(B0)<=r, and some disjoint original-coordinate leaf banks I,J satisfy s_{r+5}(E[I,J])>=gamma>0, then ||p_{X^TAX}||_infinity <= 5 sqrt(2e)/gamma for every independent cap-one input law; all other blocks and extra spectrum are arbitrary.

For every tau>0 and sufficiently large even m, A_m=[[0,g^T],[g,uu^T]] with diffuse orthogonal g,u has spectrum {-1,1,1}, is no-tau-pivot, and every original-coordinate cross block has rank at most two. Thus N3 does not imply any positive rank-three or rank-five cross-volume cut. The family is nevertheless paid by Theorem H with density <=3*4^(2/3)<7.560.

On the same A_m family, an m/2-leaf collinear spectral-row bank has total squared weight 1, compressed scalar coefficient 1/2 and |det M|=1, so account03/B19 r19 gives ||p_Q||_infinity <=16 sqrt(60) 2^(1/4)<147.385.

first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-N3-v1: fixed-tau universal density bound for every no-tau-pivot matrix with at least three eigenvalues of modulus >=1. In the canonical rank-one mixed-hub hybrid, after the new D5 exit at gamma=1/64, a surviving dense twist E must satisfy s_6(E[I,J])<1/64 for every disjoint leaf cut I,J; controlling this low-cross-rank twist uniformly is still unpaid.
